start_scene_0_3s.description: BPM Core monitor displaying elevated blood pressure (>=140 mmHg).

core_scene_3_7s.description: Correlates untreated sleep apnea with morning hypertension.

end_scene_7_10s.description: Encourages daily BP logging and strict CPAP compliance.
